description: Presidential Secretariat - Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya Deputy Speaker of the Parliament of Sri Lanka Has Resigned from Office of the Deputy Speaker from May 06, 2022
reasoning: This gazette content specifically announces the resignation of a named individual (Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya) from a government position (Deputy Speaker of the Parliament).
